subject: Renewal negotiation: incident communications & status feed (PagerFlow)
messages:
From: Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: sales@pagerflow.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PagerFlow renewal quote + initial SOW

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the heads-up on the upcoming renewal for your incident communications bundle (Acct PF-4521). Attached is our standard 12-month renewal quote and a draft SOW for the status feed + incident page product lines. The key points: a 10% standard renewal discount, includes up to 80 on-call seats and priority support (24x7).

Questions for you:
- Is Redwood committing to a 12-month reserved seat count, or do you need flexible scaling?
- Do you require on-prem/data-residency terms for EU-only customers?

If you can confirm seat count and the PO/contact for legal review, I can put together a revised contract with a pricing schedule.

Attachments: PagerFlow_renewal_quote_Mar25.pdf, SOW_draft_incident-comm.docx

Best,
Alicia Ross
Contracts Manager, PagerFlow Inc.
A: contracts@pagerflow.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PagerFlow renewal quote + initial SOW

Alicia — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications before legal and finance dig in: 

1) Seat commitment: we expect baseline 60 active on-call seats with planned bursts to 90. For pricing, can you provide a committed-annual vs. usage-based price so we can model both?
2) SLA / data residency: we need SOC 2 Type II cert (we have to show this to customers) and an EU data option for status pages that contain European incident details. Please flag any addendum required.
3) Term: we prefer a 12-month term with automatic renewal unless we provide 60-day notice.

Laura/Tessa — looping you for legal and ops input. Laura, can you run initial redlines focused on SLA, data deletion, and liability? Tessa, does this match the on-call seat forecast you shared last week?

Goal: get a redline back by COB Apr 5 so finance can evaluate before our monthly renewals commit.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

>

From: Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: sales@pagerflow.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Revised quote and draft contract (PF-4521)

Soojin —

Per our call last week, attached is a revised quote that includes a 15% committed-seat discount if Redwood commits to 12 months at 75 seats. I also attached a draft contract with the SOC 2 reference and a data processing addendum (DPA) for EU-residency options.

Key updates:
- Price: $XX,XXX/month (committed 75 seats) with overage at $X/seat
- SLA: 99.95% uptime on delivery for API-based status updates
- DPA: EU data partitioning available as add-on

Please confirm whether the 75-seat commit is acceptable or if you prefer a 60-seat baseline with burst allowances. If you can share Redwood legal contact, I’ll circulate a tracked-redline PDF.

Attachment: contract_redlines_v1.pdf

Best,
Alicia

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised quote and draft contract (PF-4521)

Alicia —

Thanks. I reviewed the draft and have a few principal redlines attached. High-level items:
1) SLA language needs explicit credit calculation for partial outages and a mutually-agreed incident verification process.
2) Limitatory liability: we propose a $1M cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months, subject to mutal exceptions for gross negligence.
3) Data deletion clause: require vendor to destroy Redwood customer data upon termination within 30 days; documentation of deletion process required.
4) DPA: add subprocessors list and require 30-day notice for changes.

I’ve attached contract_redlines_v2.pdf with tracked changes and comments. If you can accept these in principle, Alicia, we can route to finance for PO terms and then finalize counter-signature timeline. 

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Tue, 30 Mar 2027 at 11:28 AM Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com> wrote:
> Soojin —
>
> Per our call last week, attached is a revised quote that includes a 15% committed-seat discount...

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised quote and draft contract (PF-4521) — Finance questions

Alicia / team —

Finance input here: we can accept the 12-month committed pricing model but need a clear price schedule and invoice cadence. Two items to confirm before we issue PO:
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net-45 for renewals with established vendors. Can PagerFlow accommodate Net-45 instead of Net-30?
- Tax & remittance details: please supply W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU) as appropriate.

If Net-45 is acceptable we’ll prepare a PO referencing the RFQ-8475 pricing schedule and route it for signatures. Please also deliver a final DocuSign envelope once legal redlines are resolved.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Ross <contracts@pagerflow.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — PagerFlow renewal (RFQ-8475)

Alicia — looping final steps and timeline so we’re aligned: 

1) Laura’s redlines (contract_redlines_v2.pdf) are our legal baseline. Please confirm acceptance or provide countered language by EOD Apr 19.
2) Monica: once language is accepted we will issue PO with Net-45. Alicia, please confirm whether PagerFlow accepts Net-45 and will provide W-9/VAT as applicable.
3) Seat commitment: we prefer the 75-seat committed pricing to lock the 15% discount; Tessa, please confirm operationally that 75 is viable as baseline.
4) DocuSign: Alicia to send final envelope after redline resolution. Link should reference RFQ-8475.

Attached: SOW_draft_incident-comm.docx (for ops alignment). I scheduled a 30-minute sync Apr 14 at 10:00 PDT to walk remaining items — invitation sent.

If no major issues by Apr 19 we’ll proceed with countersignature and PO issuance the following week.

Thanks all,
Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
